wiki.title: Nick Schroer
wiki.extract: Nick Schroer is an American politician. He is a member of the Missouri Senate from the 2nd district, serving since 2023. He previously represented the 107th district in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023. He is a member of the Republican Party.
